entities.summary: Alain Anziani was a French politician of the Socialist Party (PS) who served as president of Bordeaux Métropole from 2020 until 2024. From 2008 to 2017, he was member of the Senate of France, representing the Gironde department, and beginning in 2014, he was mayor of Mérignac.
